name: express-okta-cerbos
description: An example stack of integrating Cerbos with an Express server using Okta for authentication and user management.

paragraphs: An example stack of integrating Cerbos with an Express server using Okta for authentication and user management.

whatItDoes.text: An example stack of integrating Cerbos with an Express server using Okta for authentication and user management.

requirements.text: For this example we will be making use of Okta's ExpressOIDC package so the application's sign-in method needs to be OIDC - OpenID Connect and the application type is Web Application.
The default redirect URLs for sign-in and sign-out are correct if you are running this demo app on the default 8080 port.
